## About IMC

Intermediate Metal Conduit (IMC) is a lighter and lower cost alternative to rigid metal conduit. IMC provides excellent protection for electrical wiring while being more economical and easier to install.

### Standards
- IMC is covered by **Article 342** of the National Electric Code (NEC)

### Key Features
- Lighter weight than rigid conduit
- Lower cost
- Durable metal construction
- Suitable for various electrical applications

### Related Products
- Electrical Metal Tubing (EMT)
- Rigid Aluminum Conduit (RAC)
- Rigid Metal Conduit (RMC)
